adjudication.rationale: `refreshOAuthTokens` (new file `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) performs a `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and returns the raw `Response` without checking `response.ok` / status. Callers then proceed to parse/use the returned data (e.g., Office365 calls `handleErrorsJson(response)` then `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)`, Zoom calls `handleZoomResponse(response, ...)` then `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)`), so a non-2xx sync-endpoint response (including an error/HTML body) can flow into downstream token parsing/handling rather than being rejected at the boundary.
